summary: Large reports now export in one step, duplicate payment emails are gone, and older mobile apps need an update.

entries.title: Export up to 50,000 rows at once
entries.description: Large CSV exports from the Reports page now complete in one step. The previous limit was 5,000 rows.

entries.title: Fixed duplicate "invoice paid" emails
entries.description: Some customers received the same payment confirmation two or three times. Each payment now sends exactly one email.
entries.internal_notes: Affected accounts: webhook retries between Sep 1-20. Safe to tell customers it's resolved.

entries.title: Older mobile app versions can no longer sign in
entries.description: To keep accounts secure, versions of the mobile app older than 4.2 can no longer sign in.
entries.action: Update the Acme app from the App Store or Google Play to version 4.2 or later.

title: Bigger exports, and no more duplicate emails
